title: RVLM-X: Towards a Universal VLM Harness
abstract: arXiv:2611.31755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Harnesses for vision-language models (VLMs) have grown with the models' capabilities, notably for images far larger than those seen in training, where downscaling loses small details. Most of them wrap the VLM in a fixed procedure, such as a zoom tree, that decides in advance where it looks and how the evidence is combined. These procedures make up for the weaknesses of older models by keeping them on a task-specific path, but with frontier models that reliably plan and use tools, they can lower accuracy. We propose RVLM-X, a task-generalizable recursive VLM harness that runs unchanged across photographs, charts and maps. Following the recursive inference of Recursive Language Models, the VLM programmatically controls its own visual context in a code REPL that holds the full-resolution image and calls itself recursively on regions that it chooses. With a cost-efficient frontier model as the base of every method, RVLM-X is more accurate

translated_title: RVLM-X：迈向通用的视觉语言模型辅助框架
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的辅助框架随着模型能力的增长而不断发展，尤其是在处理远大于训练时所见图像的场景中——此时降缩放会丢失细小细节。现有的多数框架将VLM包裹在一个固定流程中，例如缩放树（zoom tree），预先决定模型看向哪里以及如何整合证据。这些流程通过将旧模型约束在任务特定的路径上来弥补其弱点，但对于能够可靠地进行规划并使用工具的前沿模型而言，它们反而可能降低准确率。我们提出RVLM-X，一个任务可泛化的递归式VLM辅助框架，它在照片、图表和地图等任务上无需任何改动即可运行。遵循递归语言模型（Recursive Language Models）的递归推理方式，VLM在一个保存全分辨率图像的代码REPL中以编程方式控制自己的视觉上下文，并对它自行选择的区域递归地调用自身。在以具有成本效益的前沿模型作为所有方法的基础时，RVLM-X获得了更高的准确率。
tldr: RVLM-X提出了一种任务可泛化的递归式VLM辅助框架，让前沿模型在代码REPL中自主控制全分辨率图像的视觉上下文并递归调用自身，从而在照片、图表和地图等多种任务上无需改动即可提升准确率。
en_tdlr: RVLM-X introduces a task-generalizable recursive VLM harness where frontier models programmatically control their visual context in a code REPL and recursively call themselves on self-selected regions, achieving higher accuracy unchanged across photographs, charts, and maps.
